s0201.literal: Prince of Jin Yesun Temür's following suffered famine; fifty million ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0203.idiomatic: The escort retinue camps were ordered back to Dadu; trampling civilian grain fields was forbidden.

s0207.idiomatic: On bingshen day, because the 12 relay stations of Changping and Luanyang were heavily burdened with supplies, 300,000 ingots of notes were granted for relief.

s0211.idiomatic: On wuxu day Mars encroached upon Fang.

s0220.literal: to be returned to the court; he requested the relevant office collect its rent, with grain and notes granted annually; this was approved.

s0233.literal: On bingchen day Emperor Renzong the Sage, Literary, and Reverent Filial Emperor and Empress Zhuangyi the Compassionate and Sacred were enshrined in the Grand Ancestral Temple; Tiemudie'er acted as Grand Master of Ceremonies and performed the rite bearing the jade register.

s0235.literal: On wuwu day Tiemudie'er, because Zhao Shiyan had once impeached his corruption, falsely charged him with disrespect and imprisoned him, requesting his execution and also investigating secretariat and censorate officials — this was not approved.

s0253.idiomatic: On guisi day the moon encroached upon Mao.
